case: custom enum[] CSV import resolves the table type under a shadowed search_path
contract: Two schemas define a same-named enum; the search_path points to the shadow type, whose label set excludes the imported target label.
CSV import metadata and generated cast resolve the target table's schema-qualified enum array type.
The imported array retains its target native type and label while the existing sibling row remains unchanged.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families, installed array editing and additional enum/session configurations remain open in B3.
